feeds.title: Scene Point Blank Blog
feeds.description: An infrequently-updated site blog, featuring a range of content including show reviews, musical musings, and off-color ramblings on other varied topics. Read the latest punk, hardcore, indie, and alternative music blog posts from Scene Point Blank webzine. At Scene Point Blank, you'll find quality music reviews, in-depth interviews, music-minded columns, and other features.

feeds.title: Terminal Sound Nuisance
feeds.description: Terminal Sound Nuisance is a blog promoting good, genuine punk music through lengthy music reviews from a critical, sophisticated and witty perspective, providing lossless files and scans in the process. Browse Punk-related content from a range of categories and articles.

feeds.title: The Punk Site
feeds.description: ThePunkSite.com is the ultimate hub for all your punk, ska, emo, hardcore, indie & pop-punk needs. Access daily news, featured stories, reviews, interviews, photos, contests, and more from the current Punk Rock Scene.

feeds.title: THOUGHTS WORDS ACTION
feeds.description: THOUGHTS WORDS ACTION is a music review blog dedicated to the punk rock genre and related subgenres. Follow along as they dive into the latest releases and album premieres, and review and rank rock albums by your favorite bands. Discover more interesting resources on Punk Rock through their blog.

feeds.title: Dying Scene
feeds.description: Dying Scene is a Punk music blog with the latest news, reviews, shows, interviews, and album release dates for punk, ska, hardcore, emo, screamo, Celtic, and punk-folk bands. Create a band profile and join a growing community of punk rock enthusiasts passionate about reviving punk rock tradition.

feeds.title: Louder Than War Blog
feeds.description: Louder Than War is one of the UK's fastest-growing and award-winning music and culture websites. Louder Than War is a music and counter-culture website and record label that brings you all the latest music latest rock, punk, metal, and alternative music news, album and gig reviews, news and interviews as well as covering counter-culture film, TV, and art.

feeds.title: Colin's Punk Rock World
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Colin Clark and i am passionate about Punk Rock. The purpose of this blog is for me to review gigs and CDs and give my personal opinions on what gets me more excited than anything in the world - punk rock and roll.

feeds.title: Like Punk Never Happened
feeds.description: Like Punk Never Happened is a rich, refreshing collection of Punk Rock Fan Brian McCloskey's Smash Hits Archive. The blog contains cover images linked to Flickr pages featuring snapshots of all pages of that specific Smash Hits issue. Read and regale among old pictures Smash Hits magazine.

feeds.title: IDIOTEQ
feeds.description: IDIOTEQ is a DIY online magazine covering some of the hardcore punk and rock music scene and supporting DIY ethics and local bands. Gather exclusive interviews, new music premieres, tour dates, news stories and event details, and more.

feeds.title: Days of Punk Blog
feeds.description: Days of Punk Blog by Professional & Commercial Photographer Michael Grecco takes you back in time to revisit the peak and eclectic magnificence of Punk Rock in its days. Browse articles describing the queer, grimy origins and anti-mainstream philosophy of the Punk subculture along with many other interesting notes.

feeds.title: Punk Rock Photography
feeds.description: H. N. James from Punk Rock Photography is a music and portrait photographer living near and working in Nashville, TN. She offers her services to bands or artists seeking personalized photos for promotional or press kit use. James uses a mix of different elements: location, light, props, clothing, color, or black-and-white to create a wonderful expression of liveliness in photos.

feeds.title: Punk Outlaw Blog
feeds.description: Punk Outlaw Records was founded by media entrepreneur, and punk music fanatic Robert G. Rose. It is a digital record label and publishing company that focuses on importing various styles of punk, ska, rockabilly, and psychobilly music from musicians the world over. Read news updates and announcements from Punk Outlaw in this official blog.

feeds.title: The Hard Times » Punk/Hardcore
feeds.description: The Hard Times' takes on all things funny and punk. Find hard-hitting satirical headlines and articles that make you think and laugh. The Hard Times is a satirical punk news website made by a group of punk and hardcore kids from all the different sub-genres of the DIY hardcore scene.

feeds.title: Punk Rock Operations Research
feeds.description: Punk Rock Operations Research blog is written by Professor Laura Albert from the Department of Industrial & Systems Engineering at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, where she talks about her personal and academic travails, tips and more.

feeds.title: Rock Mommy
feeds.description: Rockmommy.com is a music blog curated by rocker mom, guitar teacher, and journalist Marisa Torrieri Bloom. Experience Music and Motherhood in Harmony with Marisa Torrieri as she shares moments from her motherhood and other quippy stories.

feeds.title: Personal Punk
feeds.description: Personal Punk is a Punk Rock blog by a Punk aficionado who likes to review albums and chronicle punk rock in all its sprawling, contradictory and scuzzy glory. Here you will find reviews of new DIY punk releases, books, and an ongoing project to cover the entire ACTIVE MINDS vinyl discography.

feeds.title: Faster and Louder
feeds.description: Featuring Punk and rock n' roll reviews from Lord Rutledge and enthusiast friends. Rutledge is a former head honcho at Now Wave Magazine, and loves to write about the era and affluence of '77 punk, power pop, rock n' roll, and other silly stuff.

feeds.title: Punkinfocus
feeds.description: Punkinfocus blog by Cris Watkins, a rock music photographer, covers the latest news and event in the Punk Rock scene in the UK. At Punkinfocus, we produce original news and content for fans. Punk rock is the main focus but we cover a range of music styles that float our collective boats.

feeds.title: PunkRockBeat.com
feeds.description: Punk Rock Beat delivers hard and fast news about the trends in guitar-based rock and roll, for original punk rock sounds through the garage, grunge, and goth. Published by Walsheditorial.com, PunkRockBeat is a source of info About Punk, Post Punk, Ska, Garage Rock, and Grunge music from around the globe.

feeds.title: Indie Vision Music » Punk Rock
feeds.description: Indie Vision Music was established in 2000. Online-based indie music webzine. This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with Punk Rock. Some sub-topics may include but are not limited to Indie, Heavy Metal, Indie Rock & Pop, and more.

feeds.title: punk rock and UFOs
feeds.description: Read absorbing articles on Punk music and UFOs that stoke your interest into the strange. Punk Rock and UFOs by Mike Damante aims to provide thought-provoking coverage, interviews, stories, and reviews from the worlds of multimedia, and the anomalous. Mike Damante is an author, journalist, and award-winning educator.

feeds.title: The Punk Rock Museum
feeds.description: It's been 45+ years since punk rock pogo'd its way into music, fashion, film, and popular culture. The Punk Rock Museum houses the world's most expansive, inclusive, and intimate display of artifacts, fliers, photos, clothing, instruments, handwritten lyrics, artwork, and just about everything else donated by the people and bands who were there.

feeds.title: DIY Punk Rock
feeds.description: News and Updates from the John Harcus Audio Production Company. Check out our collection of groove packs to aid your songwriting and creativity. At DIY Punk Rock, we also produce mix-ready Superior Drummer 3 presets inspired by our all-time favorite Punk albums as well as Mix-Fx packs.

feeds.title: Markus' Heavy Music Blog » Punk
feeds.description: Read news, stories, reviews, and articles on Punk in this segment of Markus' Heavy Music Blog. Hi, I'm Markus and this is my blog, where share my thoughts, reviews, and opinions on past and recently released Punk Music. I offer reviews from a perspective that takes into account the unique, emotional aspect of the song that resonates with everyone.

feeds.title: Connecticut Garage Punk Blog
feeds.description: Bringing the world's best Garage/Punk/ and Rock N Roll to southern New England. At the Connecticut Garage Punk Blog, we share, review and comment on rare, underrated punk rock music albums and also curate prepared lists for your enjoyment. Our goal is to bring you the best garage rock n roll from all over the work to our little state here in New England.

feeds.title: Punk Rock Mag
feeds.description: The Punk Rock Mag is a blog made for people who like everything about punk rock music. Read about Punk, skate punk, melodic punk, hardcore punk, ska-punk, and more. You will also find articles, musical reviews, album details, picture galleries, merchandise, and more.

feeds.title: Punk Rock Records
feeds.description: Punk Rock Records produces world-renowned music for various artists and bands since 1983. Our company was founded by Martin J. Munsch, an American record producer and recording engineer from New Jersey. Get the latest news in the music industry as well as our record label, Punk Rock Records, through this website.

feeds.title: Just Some Punk Songs
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Mike Fletcher. I like following and writing about Punk Music so i started this blog to post songs I come across that I really like. Here you will find daily posts on new, off-beat Punk songs that are often lesser-known yet good to listen to.

feeds.title: Punk Rock Saves Lives
feeds.description: Punk Rock Saves Lives (PRSL) Blog is the official platform of a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that uses punk-music events to promote mental health awareness, harm reduction (Narcan, test strips, safe-sex supplies), and bone marrow registry sign-ups through candid tour diaries, resource guides, and personal reflections from volunteers and community members.

feeds.title: Melodic Punk Style
feeds.description: Melodic Punk Style is a Polish-based skate and melodic punk music blog that publishes timely news on international punk bands, covering new singles, videos, album pre-orders, and scene updates.

feeds.title: Live Music Blog » Punk Rock
feeds.description: Live Music Blog shares the latest news on concerts, festivals, and new music. Follow us to stay updated on everything happening in live music! Punk Rock section is a dedicated space within Live Music Blog that offers timely updates on punk, featuring news, key scene obituaries, tour announcements, and emerging pop-punk singles—all delivered through concert-focused, fan-centered storytelling.

feeds.title: Wilfully Obscure
feeds.description: Wilfully Obscure is a long-running indie music blog by 'spavid' that spotlights lesser-known power pop, punk, emo, shoegaze, and indie rock offering rare album reissues, live bootlegs, demo tapes, and deep-curated mixes with thoughtful write‑ups.

feeds.title: Beat In My Bones
feeds.description: Garage Rock and Punk obsessive.

feeds.title: Post Punk
feeds.description: Post-Punk was founded in early 2004. The site is a home for Post-Punk/New Wave/Goth and related styles of music created as a central location online where fans of these more left-field styles of dance music could congregate, share reviews, and network for gigs, etc.

feeds.title: Music For The Misfits » Punk
feeds.description: Posts about Punk written by musicforthemisfits

feeds.title: Punk Rock Philosophy
feeds.description: Punk Rock Philosophy

feeds.title: Unite Asia » Punk Rock
feeds.description: Unite Asia's Punk Rock category spotlights the thriving underground punk, hardcore, and metal scenes across Asia, delivering news on new releases, music videos, band interviews, tour updates, and scene reports from countries like Malaysia, Thailand, China, Korea, and beyond.

feeds.title: Metal Odyssey > Punk Rock
feeds.description: Posts about Punk rock written by Metal Odyssey

feeds.title: Razorcake
feeds.description: Razorcake is a magazine dedicated to DIY punk, independent culture, and amplifying unheard voices.

feeds.title: Yellow Green Red
feeds.description: Music reviews and artist interviews on a biweekly basis. Featured artists include FNU Ronnies, Cold Cave, Ooga Boogas, Watery Love, Circuit Des Yeux, Tin Man, Mr. Raoul K, Ricardo Villalobos, Endless Humiliation, Ash Pool, Bloodyminded, Fresh Meat, Bare Wires, Group Doueh, Ramadanman, Sis, Tyvek, Pink Reason and many more.

feeds.title: V13.net » Hardcore/Punk
feeds.description: V13.net is a leading web destination for all things 'heavy music' inclusive of Alternative, Rock, Punk, Hardcore, Metal, and Indie coverage. It also covers music, film, TV, documentaries, pop culture, and socio-political stories.

feeds.title: 8Sided Blog
feeds.description: 8sided blog is a digital celebration of sound, culture, and what Andrew Weatherall once referred to as the punk rock dream. It's also the online home of Michael Donaldson, a slightly jaded but surprisingly optimistic fellow who once competed under the name Q-Burns Abstract Message. Discover more through their blog about music.

feeds.title: Skatepunkers
feeds.description: Skatepunkers is a web community founded in 2007 aimed at spreading and furthering The Skate Punk music and culture. Read the latest posts detailing recent albums in the genre and upcoming releases as well as enjoy curated Spotify playlists for the Skatepunker inside you.

feeds.title: Suburban Voice
feeds.description: Suburban Voice is an online magazine published by Al Quint, a Radio-show host known for his show Sonic Overload. He describes and shares his insights about the Punk and Alternative Rock Scene. Read top 10 lists, reviews, personal stories from Al, and more articles.

feeds.title: Independent Music Promotions » Punk Rock
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from the current Punk Rock scene, word on new releases, and album drops. At Independent Music Promotions, we provide full-service music PR campaigns for independent musicians of all genres. All our services are strictly based on gaining high amounts of press for chosen bands and solo artists.

feeds.title: Punk Rock Classrooms Blog
feeds.description: Punk Rock Classrooms by Mike Earnshaw and Joe Buckley outlines a series of educational and informative self-help articles focused on children and music enthusiasts. At Punk Rock Classrooms, we believe that the punk rock mindset is perfect for education, and the ideas found in punk rock can create classrooms and schools where students and staff are engaged and part of the culture and learning.

feeds.title: Punk Scholars Network Blog
feeds.description: Punk Scholars Network is an international forum for academic and scholarly debate, conferences, publications, talks, and public exhibitions. We aim to mirror the conflicting and diverse nature of Punk Culture through a genuinely interdisciplinary approach to our subject and the contribution and participation of punk scholars, fans, and enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Punk Rock and Coffee
feeds.description: This is a blog about the realities of life touring in a hardcore punk band and the adventures that come with it. Author Besatt narrates her life swinging from living in a Rock band to forming a family and current ventures. Read more about her upcoming book on music in recent blog posts.

feeds.title: Still in Rock » Punk
feeds.description: Still in Rock is a Brooklyn / Amsterdam-based webzine featuring garage rock, slacker, post-skate, surf & more!!! Read Punk news & updates, Reviews, about artists, new albums & singles, and more. Still in Rock is the go-to source for Punk Rock fanatics and a platforms in the industry to stay updated about Punk.

feeds.title: Punk Head Blog
feeds.description: Dive into the scuzzy, dreary depths of Punk and Alternative rock with gritty odes and tributes to some of your favorite Punk singles. Punk Head is an online publication that spans mainstream, indie, and alternative rock. Grab the latest music reviews, news, interviews, opinions, and analysis.

feeds.title: Indie Music Spin » Punk Rock
feeds.description: We write about Punk Rock in this segment of the blog. We will also be sharing a little about other music genres, reviews, artists, and more. Indie Music Spin's vision is to create a unique space where music fans and artists can come to explore and discover unique new music. We aim to filter out the noise and provide you with musical treasures that you will feel connected to.

feeds.title: Punx In Solidarity
feeds.description: Punx In Solidarity is created and operated by Rich Monday and Mat Finnegan. We are freelancers, writers, musicians, and advocates, of the Punk Culture. At P.I.S. We all come together to bring our talents to our collective table of hardcore minds. Read music reviews, Punk news, and Political articles here.

feeds.title: Punk Rock Anthropology
feeds.description: Punk Rock Anthropology is devoted to all things punk: music mixes, reviews, and content on the culture. It is meant as a space for punk fans of all colors and genders to discuss their punk subcultures and music knowledge. Dive into the best-recommended punk albums, singles, discussions and more.

feeds.title: Punk World Views
feeds.description: Exclusive Punk/Metal/Hardcore Coverage. PWV was founded in 2008 by Denise Borders. This site focuses on music news, album reviews, interviews and live concert coverage. We pride ourselves on providing original and unique content and the highest quality photos/video online.

feeds.title: Crust With Strings Blog
feeds.description: Crust With Strings by Youtube user Squeek is a Blog about Punk music, especially that produced by String Instruments. Find Album Descriptions, Tracklists, Band profiles, and other eclectic anecdotes that appeal to the string music enthusiast inside you.

feeds.title: UltraBomb
feeds.description: Official channel of the punk rock power trio UltraBomb. Get live News updates, Tour Schedules, and more exclusive details from Ultrabomb, an international Punk Rock band featuring Greg Norton (Husker DU), Finny McConnell (The Mahones), and Jamie Oliver (UK Subs/SNFU).
